trial_court: Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura - T.S. (Divorce) No. 228 of 2006
case_name: Smt. Baby Deb vs Ajit Deb
facts_of_case: Petitioner presented a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(1a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The court-fee was affixed as Re. 1/- but there was a deficit of Rupees 19/-. The trial court directed the petitioner to supply additional court-fee within 31st January, 2007.

legal_principles.principle: A plaint shall contain the following particulars.
legal_principles.held: The plaint shall contain the name of the Court in which the suit is brought, the name, description and place of residence of the plaintiff, the name, description and place of residence of the defendant, so far as they can be ascertained.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order IV

legal_principles.principle: A plaint shall not be deemed to be duly instituted unless it complies with the requirements specified in Sub-rules (1) and (2).
legal_principles.held: The plaint shall not be deemed to be duly instituted unless it complies with the requirements specified in Sub-rules (1) and (2).
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order IV

outcome.final_order: The impugned order is set aside and the petition is being disposed of at the admission stage itself.
